caption: The video captures a sunlit balcony corner where a small woven straw basket holding a leafy green plant sits centered on a pale tiled floor. Behind it, a large reddish-brown terracotta planter supports a taller plant with broad dark-green leaves and a thin trunk. A green plastic watering can rests stationary at the right edge, while dark vertical railing bars line the left against a pinkish wall. Throughout the excerpt, the slender stems and leaves of the basket plant sway gently, the right-side and left-side sprigs shifting their angle from frame to frame. The broad leaves of the upper plant likewise show small positional shifts, and the dappled shadows on the floor move and reshape in sync. The basket, terracotta pot, watering can, railing, and floor lines remain fixed, and no water flows from the spout. No person or hand enters the scene, so the source of the air movement is not directly visible. The camera stays effectively static as the foliage drifts.
